Thanks for sending the redlines. A couple quick asks from the onboarding side:

1) Can you confirm the internal attendees for the onboarding playbook (product owner + infra lead ideally)? That helps us tailor the deck.
2) We prefer to keep the legal redline call focused (legal + counsel + Redwood legal); the onboarding session should include SSO and data-handling owners.

If useful, I've attached our onboarding playbook draft — it's not final but includes the smoke-test checklist we usually run. If you want us to run the SSO smoke test ahead of the onboarding review, we can do a 20-minute connect on Tue 9/30 at 08:15 PT before the redline time.

- 0–10 min introductions & scope
- 10–35 min legal redlines (Tom + counsel)
- 35–55 min onboarding playbook + SSO highlights
- 55–75 min Q&A / next steps
